description: Ethics pack for the Windows laptop at 8B scale (laptop 8b; Intel Lunar Lake + Arc iGPU, Ollama, local judge): the 8B cross-family pair decides the same six dilemmas as the 3B laptop_ethics run, so the two runs compare like for like -- colony caretaking, triage, rescue dispatch, confidentiality vs safety, generation-ship policy, and whistleblowing. Each scenario carries its own local qwen3:8b judge with criteria tailored to its dilemma, grading the decision record: consistency as the price rises, honesty about costs, engagement. The profile supplies the contestants and duel settings only, so the scenarios' judges survive; settings match laptop_ethics exactly so contestant scale is the only changed variable.
